Appreciated the Gazette and Xmas card and wishes all members a happy New Year. Les Bennett is still amongst the missing in Malaya. His wife, Olive, writes: "It is over a year since I last heard from my husband.
However, a week's rest in hospital, with the sister of Joe and Jack Flower to hold his hand, soon put him right again. Les Bennett.
Trust a Belgrave man to find his way to the food! Les Bennett. No further news has been received since we heard that he was a P.O.W. in Japan.

We are still awaiting to hear further news of Les Bennett who is still in Japanese hands. Arthur Beales seems to have settled down to life in a prison camp, and has "made himself at home," if such a phrase applies!
Les Bennett.
